_build: Every folder of documents under `root` gets its own OKF in `out`, plus one for the loose files at the top and a mesh OKF over all of them. `exclude` drops a folder inside `root`; `include` adds a tree outside it. `decisions` is excluded because it is an in-place bundle — those files are the concepts, so mirroring them would be a second copy of knowledge that already exists.
_enrich: Level 2+ — a model on hardware you control, so no key and no bill, but OKFM does the drafting. Nothing in the pipeline reads this; only `okfm.py enrich-local`, which is the one component declaring `needs: [model]`. `enabled` is separate from `model` because naming a model is saying which one, not saying to call it. The model must already be pulled on that Ollama instance.
_bundle_tags: Levels 1 and 2 are needs-nothing BY DEFINITION — that is the boundary dev/check_levels.py enforces, and it is a property of the bundle rather than of any file in it. level-3-enrich is deliberately absent: its components differ, so a blanket tag there would assert something false.
